name: mud-draugr-lake
description: Sulfurous Mud next to Draugr piles (D-015): the placement puts mud next to a pile standing in the test world's lake (under water), none next to a pile on dry ground, and a generated swamp ruin's pile asks for it. (A whole ruin in the lake digs its own 20 m hole into this flat world, so the water case runs the real placer at the lake floor; run extra3c.)
